lines.en: label dormwartwo6:
scene nightsky
It feels wrong leaving one girl to meet up with another, but it feels even worse when your cum still clings to the fabric of the first girl’s clothes.
lines.zh: 丢下一个女孩去见另一个女孩，感觉确实很糟糕；但当你的精液还黏在第一个女孩的衣服上时，那种感觉更糟。

lines.en: On the way to see Noriko, I think about what Futaba must be doing right now. Whether she decided to return to her friends...If she was even able to move in the first place...
lines.zh: 在去见 Noriko 的路上，我想着 Futaba 此刻会在做什么。她有没有决定回到朋友们身边……她一开始到底还能不能动……

lines.en: Or if she’s perhaps still sprawled out across the deep, red blankets that countless couples before us have defiled.
lines.zh: 又或者，她或许还四仰八叉地躺在那床深红色的毯子上——那床被我们之前无数对情侣玷污过的毯子。

lines.en: It’s thoughts like this that I try to save for when I’m alone- for they abruptly perish the moment another pretty face leaps into my field of vision.
lines.zh: 这样的念头我总是留到独处时才去想——因为一旦有另一张漂亮的脸跳进我的视野，它们就会戛然而止。

lines.en: The one I will see tonight is one of the prettiest of them all.
lines.zh: 今晚我要见的那一个，是其中最漂亮的之一。

lines.en: But that’s not because she’s more suited to my tastes (She is).
lines.zh: 但这并不是因为她的长相更合我的口味（她是）。

lines.en: And it’s not because she’s one of the only girls who I think can handle the type of person I am beneath the masks I wear for everyone who’s not (She is).
lines.zh: 也不是因为她是极少数几个、我觉得能承受住摘下那些给外人戴的面具之后的我的女孩之一（她是）。

lines.en: It’s not even because she’s my polar opposite (Once more, she is).
lines.zh: 甚至也不是因为她和我截然相反（再一次，她是）。

lines.en: Her face is one of the prettiest because it’s a face that dates back to before the other ones even existed in this makeshift world of mine.
lines.zh: 她的脸之所以是最漂亮的之一，是因为这张脸的年代，远早于其他那些脸出现在我这个拼凑出来的世界里。

lines.en: My memories of it are buried right now, but I’ve been getting better at digging...and I believe that one day, even if it’s “years” from now, I’ll be able to unearth them.
lines.zh: 关于它的记忆此刻被埋在土里，但我越来越擅长挖掘了……我相信总有一天，哪怕是从现在算起的「好几年」之后，我也能把它们挖出来。

lines.en: And the only reason I can even think of things like that in the first place is because of people like her.
lines.zh: 而我之所以还能想到这些，全都是因为有像她这样的人。

lines.en: People who supplement my existence by being everything I need them to be...Who change themselves when I can’t figure out what that is.
lines.zh: 她们用「成为我所需要的一切」来补足我的存在……当我想不出自己需要什么时，她们就自己改变自己。

lines.en: The people I don’t deserve are always the ones who want me the most. And that’s horrible for everyone as it means they’re also the easiest to hurt.
lines.zh: 我配不上的人，往往是最想要我的人。这对所有人来说都很可怕，因为那也意味着她们是最容易被伤到的。

lines.en: So tonight, I will do my best to not lacerate the pale skin of a dream girl with the poison-tipped edge of a blade that is my tongue.
lines.zh: 所以今晚，我会尽全力不用那条舌头——那把淬了毒的刀刃——去划开梦中女孩苍白的皮肤。

lines.en: I will ask myself if this is worth it.
lines.zh: 我会问自己，这值不值得。

lines.en: If her body can handle one more scar after all of the ones I’ve given her already.
lines.zh: 在我已经给了她那么多伤疤之后，她的身体还承受得住再多一道吗。

lines.en: And if she’s still beautiful despite wearing all of them for the whole world to see.
lines.zh: 还有，当她戴着所有这些伤疤、让全世界都看见时，她是否依然美丽。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko1
She is.
lines.zh: 她是。

lines.en: : I’m late.
lines.zh: : 我来晚了。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko2
: You are.
lines.zh: : 你确实晚了。

lines.en: : I take it that means date number one went well?
lines.zh: : 那我是不是可以理解为，第一次约会进行得很顺利？

lines.en: : Am I allowed to talk about date number one here? Because Futaba had a rule where I wasn’t allowed to bring you up.
lines.zh: : 在这儿我能聊第一次约会的事吗？因为 Futaba 定过规矩，不许我提起你。

lines.en: : Do you always bring me up in conversations with other girls? Or were you just so excited to see me tonight that you weren’t able to hold it in?
lines.zh: : 你跟别的女孩子聊天时总是会提到我吗？还是说你今晚太想见我了，实在憋不住？

lines.en: : If I was that excited, would I have really shown up this late?
lines.zh: : 如果我真有那么想见你，我还会来得这么晚吗？

lines.en: : Maybe. I {i}did{/i} make you come all the way to the center of the urban district after all. And all you had to do to meet up with Futaba was walk a few blocks.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。毕竟我{i}可是{/i}让你大老远跑到市中心来。而你去见 Futaba 只要走几个街区就到了。

lines.en: : You’re right. Which means this better be the most exciting date I’ve ever had or it just won’t be worth the time commitment.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。那也就是说，今晚最好是我这辈子最刺激的一次约会，不然就对不起我花的时间了。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko3
: I’ll do my best. I can’t guarantee my {i}strategy{/i} will be the same as hers, though.
lines.zh: : 我尽力。不过我不能保证我的{i}策略{/i}会和她的一样。

lines.en: : Because instead of carefully curating a list of things you might like, I’ve decided to give you a taste of {i}my{/i} world instead...
lines.zh: : 因为我没有仔细列一张你可能喜欢的事物的清单，而是决定让你尝尝{i}我的{/i}世界……

lines.en: : Even if that taste leaves an uncomfortable or unfamiliar flavor on your tongue for the rest of the week.
lines.zh: : 哪怕那个味道会在你舌头上留下整整一周都不舒服、或者陌生的余味。

lines.en: : Are you some kind of criminal at night or something? What sort of things do you do that might leave a...bad flavor on my tongue?
lines.zh: : 你晚上是去干什么犯罪的勾当了吗？你都做些什么事，会在我舌头上留下……怪味？

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko4
: Well, to start, I was thinking we could hit up my favorite male-dominated orgy spot. Then maybe follow that up by dropping acid together at the bottom of the sinkhole that claimed my Stratocaster.
lines.zh: : 首先，我想我们可以先去我最喜欢的那家以男性为主的群交场所。然后，也许我们可以一起去那个吞噬了我那把 Stratocaster 的天坑底部嗑点迷幻药。

lines.en: : Oh, and no night is complete without a trip to the nursing home- where we will pretend to be the grandchildren of Alzheimer's patients before stealing all of their wallets.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，没有去一趟养老院的夜晚是不完整的——在那儿我们会假装自己是阿尔茨海默症患者的孙辈，然后把他们所有的钱包都偷走。

lines.en: : This is all after making you eat a nine course vegan dinner featuring nothing but different variations of grilled tofu coated in American condiments, of course. Oh, and I’m also bringing my boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 当然，这些都是在逼你吃完一顿九道菜的纯素晚餐之后——每道菜都是裹着美式调味料的不同种类的烤豆腐。哦，另外我还会带上我男朋友。

lines.en: : Either you’re trying to lose on purpose through another reckless bout of self-sacrifice or we’re going to need to have a serious talk about your hobbies soon.
lines.zh: : 要么你是想通过又一次不计后果的自我牺牲来故意输掉，要么我们就得尽快好好谈谈你的爱好了。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko2
: Sensei, I love you.
lines.zh: : 老师，我爱你。

lines.en: : Good, get it all out of your system before your “boyfriend” shows up.
lines.zh: : 很好，趁你「男朋友」还没来，先把这些话都倒干净。

lines.en: : I will. Later.
lines.zh: : 我会的。等会儿。

lines.en: : I can’t guarantee it will be {i}all{/i} of it though, since I’ve been banking this love for what feels like a million years now.
lines.zh: : 不过我不能保证能一次{i}倒干净{/i}，毕竟这份爱我已经攒了好像有一百万年了。

lines.en: : I don’t mind you saving some. I’m going to need it for the next male-dominated orgy to be sure that you’re still interested in me.
lines.zh: : 你留点我也没意见。下一场以男性为主的群交，我还得靠它确认你是不是还对我有兴趣。

lines.en: : You’re the only person I’ll ever be interested in.
lines.zh: : 我永远只会对一个人感兴趣，那就是你。

lines.en: : Then why do you keep running in the opposite direction?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么一直朝着相反的方向跑？

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko1
: I’m hoping it’s for the same reasons it’s taking you so long to catch me.
lines.zh: : 我希望，和你花了这么久才追上我的原因是一样的。

lines.en: : What does-
lines.zh: : 什么意——

lines.en: : We should get going. Tickets to the orgy are 5,000 yen each, but I can spot you this time so long as you don’t try any weird positions on me while I have the helmet on.
lines.zh: : 我们该走了。群交的门票是每人五千日元，不过这次我可以请你——只要我戴着头盔的时候你别对我用什么奇怪的体位就行。

lines.en: : The...what?
lines.zh: : 那个……什么？

lines.en: scene black
: Oh, and my safe word is “harder.”
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，我的安全词是「更用力」。

lines.en: : That’s one of the actual worst words you could have chosen for that.
lines.zh: : 你选的这个词，真的能算是最烂的安全词之一了。

lines.en: : I know. {i}I like the thrill.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我知道。{i}我就喜欢刺激。{/i}

lines.en: Noriko peels herself off of the bike rack she’s been clinging to and grabs my hand without so much as a second thought.
lines.zh: Noriko 从她一直靠着的那排自行车架上直起身，想都没想就抓住了我的手。

lines.en: And while that’s fine given this {i}is{/i} a date and whatnot, I’m already receiving mixed signals about whether or not it’s okay to come any closer.
lines.zh: 虽然考虑到这{i}是{/i}在约会之类的，这样也没什么问题，但我接收到的信号已经很矛盾了——我到底能不能再靠近一点。

lines.en: One minute, she wants me to be with her sister...The next, she’s telling me she loves me.
lines.zh: 上一分钟，她还想让我和她姐姐在一起……下一分钟，她又在说她爱我。

lines.en: And that sort of back and forth would be fine if not for the fact that I can not even lift my head in this god damn city without seeing yet another face from my past.
lines.zh: 这种反复本来也没什么，如果不是因为在这座该死的城市里，我只要一抬头就会看见又一张来自我过去的脸。

lines.en: One that looks so similar to the one beside me that I have to constantly remind myself it's not {i}her{/i} I am with.
lines.zh: 那张脸和我身边的这张如此相似，以至于我得不断提醒自己，和我在一起的不是{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: But she watches us.
lines.zh: 可她在看着我们。

lines.en: She looks down with a fake smile plastered over her face as her eyes tear holes in the temporary, shared flesh of mine and Noriko’s hands.
lines.zh: 她低头看着我们，脸上挂着假笑，目光却在我和 Noriko 那只短暂交握的手上灼出一个个洞。

lines.en: She looks up as well when she realizes I’ve been doing it.
lines.zh: 当她发现我也在看她时，她也抬起了头。

lines.en: And then she loosens her grip.
lines.zh: 然后她松开了手。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko5
: I’m not gonna lie, this is the single most {i}clothed{/i} orgy I’ve ever been to.
lines.zh: : 说真的，这是我参加过穿得最{i}整齐{/i}的一场群交了。

lines.en: : Damn. If I knew you were so experienced, I would have taken you to the one on the roof of my old chiropractor’s building. I always loved {i}getting adjusted{/i} there.
lines.zh: : 靠。早知道你这么有经验，我就带你去我以前那个脊椎按摩师那栋楼的天台上那场了。我一直很喜欢在那儿{i}「被调整」{/i}。

lines.en: : For the record, I’m not a big fan of this “joking about having sex with other guys” thing.
lines.zh: : 我先声明，我可不太喜欢你这种「拿和别的男人上床开玩笑」的玩法。

lines.en: : Do you think {i}I’m{/i} a fan of having to constantly hear about you having sex with Kirin?
lines.zh: : 你觉得{i}我{/i}就喜欢一直听你说你和 Kirin 上床的事吗？

lines.en: : Wasn’t it you who said she gets to have my penis?
lines.zh: : 不是你自己说的吗，我的阴茎归她。

lines.en: : In a desperate attempt to keep clinging to you by any means necessary, yes.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那是我为了不惜一切代价继续缠着你，绝望之下说的话。

lines.en: : Do you want me to stop sleeping with her?
lines.zh: : 你想让我别再和她睡了吗？

lines.en: : What do you think?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢？

lines.en: : I think that you should start answering questions a little more honestly rather than trying to figure out what I {i}want{/i} your response to be.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你应该开始更诚实地回答问题，而不是揣摩我{i}想{/i}让你怎么回答。

lines.en: : Are we having a talk now? Do you want to go back outside?
lines.zh: : 我们现在是要谈点什么吗？你想回到外面去谈吗？

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko6
: No, it’s fine. I didn’t mean to bring the mood down. You’re obviously free to joke about whatever you want to joke about and I have nothing to do with it.
lines.zh: : 不，没事。我不是故意要扫兴。你当然想开什么玩笑就开什么玩笑，跟我没关系。

lines.en: : Sensei, just for the record, I’m totally fine with you being a little possessive of me. And I don’t mind holding off on jokes like that in the slightest if they actually make you uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 老师，我还是先声明一下，你对我有一点占有欲，我完全不介意。如果那种玩笑真的让你不舒服，我也丝毫不会介意以后不再说。

lines.en: : If you’re going to keep changing yourself to fit my needs, at least do it quietly. It feels weird when you announce it out loud.
lines.zh: : 如果你打算继续为了迎合我而改变自己，至少悄悄改。你大声说出来会让我很别扭。

lines.en: : Am I allowed to say “I’ll keep that in mind” or is that too close to doing the thing you literally just told me not to do?
lines.zh: : 那我可以说「我会记住的」吗？还是说这也算是在做你刚刚才叫我别做的事？

lines.en: : You know what? Look at me and I’ll pretend to mouth some words or something and then you can just tell me the music in here is too loud and that you can’t hear me. Go.
lines.zh: : 这样吧。你看着我，我假装动动嘴说点什么，然后你就说这里音乐太吵，听不见我说什么。来吧。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko7
: Noriko-
lines.zh: : Noriko——

lines.en: : You know you...
lines.zh: : 你知道你……

lines.en: : The music in here is too loud. I can’t hear you.
lines.zh: : 这里的音乐太吵了。我听不见你说什么。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko8
: Want me to come a little closer and whisper into your ear?
lines.zh: : 要我再靠近一点，凑到你耳边说吗？

lines.en: : Sure. I bet everyone in here would love to see a guy in his thirties cozy up to a high schooler.
lines.zh: : 好啊。我敢说这里所有人都很想看一个三十多岁的男人贴着一个女高中生。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko9
: So, this is obviously going to sound a little weird but, in this very specific scenario, I think they actually would.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这话听起来肯定有点怪，不过在这种非常特定的情境下，我觉得他们确实会想看。

lines.en: : Just where the hell did you take me?
lines.zh: : 你到底把我带到什么地方来了？

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko10
: A live house. Or a venue. Whatever you want to call it.
lines.zh: : 一个 live house。或者叫演出场地。随你怎么叫。

lines.en: : It’s a place where local bands and artists come to play music and hang out. They do stuff like art galleries and flea markets on off days too.
lines.zh: : 本地的乐队和艺人会来这儿演出、混在一起的地方。没演出的时候，他们也会搞点艺术展、跳蚤市场之类的。

lines.en: : Before I started going to Kumon-mi High, I would come here at least, like...three or four times a week.
lines.zh: : 在我开始去 Kumon-mi 学园上学之前，我一周至少会来这儿……三四次吧。

lines.en: : It’s dirty...and loud. And it smells kind of weird. And the girls’ restroom looks like somebody tossed a bag full of pipe bombs into it.
lines.zh: : 这里很脏……很吵。味道也有点怪。女厕所看起来就像有人往里面扔了一整袋钢管炸弹。

lines.en: : But it also...
lines.zh: : 但它也……

lines.en: : It also feels like home.
lines.zh: : 它也让我有种家的感觉。

lines.en: : I can’t really describe it.
lines.zh: : 我真的说不上来。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko11
: The people...the music...the whole fucking scene...
lines.zh: : 那些人……那些音乐……整个该死的场面……

lines.en: : It’s like a dopamine hit every time I step through the doors. A place where I can be the {i}real{/i} me. Not the one who subconsciously customized herself to appeal to you one day.
lines.zh: : 每当我踏进那扇门，就像被打了一针多巴胺。在那儿我可以做{i}真正{/i}的自己。而不是那个下意识把自己改造成讨你喜欢的样子的人。

lines.en: : Those parts of me are still real, don’t get me wrong. It’s extremely important to me to always be as genuine as I can, but that’s something I picked up from you a long time ago.
lines.zh: : 别误会，我的那些部分也依然是真实的。尽可能真诚对我来说极其重要——但那是我很早以前从你身上学来的。

lines.en: : It’s less...“make me into the girl you want me to be” and more...“aren’t you impressed by what I’ve become?”
lines.zh: : 与其说是「把我变成你想要的那个女孩」，不如说是……「我变成现在这样，你难道不佩服吗？」

lines.en: : Of course I’m impressed. And I know you’re your own person.
lines.zh: : 我当然佩服。而且我知道你是独立的个体。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko12
: It just feels like sometimes you’re afraid of that.
lines.zh: : 只是有时候，感觉你好像会害怕这一点。

lines.en: : We’re all afraid of something.
lines.zh: : 人都会有害怕的东西。

lines.en: : But, let me ask you this...do you really think I would have brought you somewhere like {i}this{/i} if I was still trying to appeal to you?
lines.zh: : 不过我问你……如果我还在一心想讨好你，你觉得我会把你带到{i}这种{/i}地方来吗？

lines.en: : This place is my...olive branch. My way of pulling you into my world because I want you to experience where I’ve been and {i}who I’ve become{/i} in the time we spent away from each other.
lines.zh: : 这地方就是我的……橄榄枝。是我把你拉进我的世界的方式，因为我想让你体验我们分开的这段时间里，我去过哪里、{i}变成了谁{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s not enough to just live in your world anymore.
lines.zh: : 光是活在你的世界里，已经不够了。

lines.en: : I want our worlds to collide.
lines.zh: : 我想让我们的世界相撞。

lines.en: : I want to love you in both of them.
lines.zh: : 我想在两个世界里都爱你。

lines.en: : And I want {i}you{/i} to love me in them as well.
lines.zh: : 我也想让{i}你{/i}在两个世界里都爱我。

lines.en: : But you also want me to love your sister...which makes this entire exchange shallow and hypocritical.
lines.zh: : 可你又想让我去爱你姐姐……这让上面这整段话变得既肤浅又虚伪。

lines.en: : I know. But...here’s another thing, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我知道。不过……还有一件事，老师。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko13
: I’m a fucking {i}teenager.{/i} I’m still growing in a bunch of different ways.
lines.zh: : 我就是个他妈的{i}未成年人{/i}。我还在好多不同的方面成长着。

lines.en: : You’re not hanging out with the complete version of Noriko Nakayarakawayama yet. I’m still just a prototype. And prototypes are always a little bit worse than the final version.
lines.zh: : 你现在见到的，还不是完整版的 Noriko Nakayarakawayama。我还只是个原型机。而原型机总是会比最终版差一点。

lines.en: : So, for a while, I’m probably going to keep doing things you don’t understand. Hell, I’m probably going to keep doing things {i}I{/i} don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 所以在接下来的一段时间里，我大概还会继续做一些你不理解的事。操，我大概还会继续做一些{i}我自己{/i}都不理解的事。

lines.en: : But that isn’t me being flaky...It’s me trying to figure shit out.
lines.zh: : 但那不是我反复无常……那是我在试着把事情想明白。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko14
: I’ve got all these different values and dreams...and I keep trying to shove them into this little box labeled “Noriko,” but it can only fit so much.
lines.zh: : 我有一大堆各不相同的价值观和梦想……我一直想把它们全塞进这个写着「Noriko」的小盒子里，可它装不下那么多。

lines.en: : And every single time I hypothetically sit down to hypothetically sort all of these hypothetical things I hypothetically hope to do one day...do you know what the first thing that goes into the box is?
lines.zh: : 而每一次我假设性地坐下来、假设性地去整理所有这些我假设性希望有一天能做的事……你知道第一个被放进盒子里的东西是什么吗？

lines.en: : It’s me, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是我吧？

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko15
: No. It’s Oreos.
lines.zh: : 不是。是奥利奥。

lines.en: : But you’re a close second.
lines.zh: : 不过你排在第二，差不了多少。

lines.en: : Sorry to interrupt such a precious moment, but do you still want to do that thing, Noriko? Because we’ve only got thirty minutes before sound check for the next band.
lines.zh: : 抱歉打扰这么珍贵的时刻，不过 Noriko，你还要做那件事吗？因为距离下一支乐队试音只剩三十分钟了。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko16
: Thing?
lines.zh: : 那件事？

lines.en: : Yeah. I still want to do it.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我还是想做。

lines.en: : What {i}thing?{/i} What are you doing?
lines.zh: : {i}什么事？{/i}你要做什么？

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko17
: The same thing I’ve always been doing.
lines.zh: : 我一直都在做的那件事。

lines.en: : Trying to impress you.
lines.zh: : 试着让你刮目相看。

lines.en: : Noriko-
lines.zh: : Noriko——

lines.en: : Finish your beer and get your ass over to the front of the stage.
lines.zh: : 把你的啤酒喝完，然后滚到舞台前面去。

lines.en: scene black
scene datewarnoriko18
: Attention, everyone! Move forward. Come on, come on, come on. You can do it. We’re all family here.
lines.zh: : 大家注意了！往前站。来吧，来吧，来吧。你们做得到的。在这儿我们都是一家人。

lines.en: : I see a lot of new faces out there, so some of you might not remember me. But I’ve been coming to this place for a long time now.
lines.zh: : 我看到下面有不少新面孔，所以有些人可能不记得我了。不过我来这个地方已经很久了。

lines.en: : And even though I can’t make it out as much as I used to, it still holds a very special place in my heart.
lines.zh: : 虽然我现在来得没有以前那么勤了，它在我心里依然占着一个非常特别的位置。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko19
: But that’s not the {i}only{/i} thing here that holds a special place in my heart.
lines.zh: : 不过，在这里占着我心里那个特别位置的，{i}不止是{/i}这个地方。

lines.en: : AWWWWWW YEAH! GET IT GIRL!
lines.zh: AWWWWWW YEAH! 加油啊姑娘！

lines.en: The crowd, as small as it may be, erupts into a fit of cheers and laughter as Noriko locks eyes with me.
lines.zh: 人群虽然不多，却爆发出一阵欢呼和笑声，而 Noriko 就在这时和我锁住了目光。

lines.en: : Anyone who’s talked to me before has probably heard my story of “the one who got away” who...also happened to be my sister’s ex-boyfriend...But! That is beside the point!
lines.zh: : 以前跟我聊过天的人，大概都听过我那个「错过的人」的故事……而那个人恰好也是我姐姐的前男友……不过！那都不重要！

lines.en: : Because, you see...I’ve had a streak of very good luck lately.
lines.zh: : 因为，你们看……我最近走了好长一串好运。

lines.en: : Because not only was I able to reunite with him...I was able to start rekindling the relationship we once had...
lines.zh: : 因为我不仅和他重逢了……还能重新开始点燃我们曾经的那段感情……

lines.en: : I was able to start making new friends and experiencing new things.
lines.zh: : 我还开始结交新朋友、体验新事物。

lines.en: : And today, I had the best luck of all...because I was able to bring him here and share this experience with him.
lines.zh: : 而今天，我迎来了最好运的一刻……因为我能把他带到这里，和他分享这段经历。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko20
: Now, it’s been a while since I’ve done anything like this. So please forgive me if I’m a little bit rusty and try not to laugh if I forget my own words.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我已经很久没做这种事了。所以如果有点生疏，请你们原谅；要是我忘了自己写的词，也尽量别笑我。

lines.en: : This is a song I wrote a few months ago called “Smells of Summer” and you’ll all be the first and...probably last group of people to ever hear it.
lines.zh: : 这是我几个月前写的一首歌，叫《Smells of Summer》（夏日的气味）。你们会是第一批……大概也是最后一批听到它的人。

lines.en: scene black
: But what’s even more important than that is making sure the person I dragged here today hears it.
lines.zh: : 但比这更重要的是，要确保我今天硬拉来的那个人听到它。

lines.en: : And that he sees firsthand just how far I’ve come.
lines.zh: : 还要让他亲眼看见，我已经走了多远。

lines.en: : Even if he can’t quite remember where I started.
lines.zh: : 哪怕他已经记不清我是从哪里出发的。

lines.en: Noriko snatches an acoustic guitar out of the bartender’s hand and, after making sure it’s tuned, she signals to the crowd to remain silent.
lines.zh: Noriko 从酒保手里一把抓过一把木吉他，确认过音准之后，她示意人群安静下来。

lines.en: I watch on in awe, unsure of what to expect or how to process what’s happening.
lines.zh: 我敬畏地看着，不知道该期待什么，也不知道该怎么消化眼前发生的事。

lines.en: I just know that I need to pay attention.
lines.zh: 我只知道，我必须全神贯注。

lines.en: That I need to watch her grow.
lines.zh: 我必须看着她成长。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko21
scene datewarnoriko22
She doesn’t need to search for me after opening her eyes. She remembers my exact spot and the angle her pupils need to maintain in order to build a shelter within mine.
lines.zh: 她睁开眼后并不需要寻找我。她记得我确切的位置，也记得她的瞳孔需要保持怎样的角度，才能在我的瞳孔里搭起一个庇护所。

lines.en: When she sings, she sings to me. And there are other people who can hear her, sure- but none of this matters to them.
lines.zh: 她唱的时候，是唱给我听的。当然也有别人能听见她——但这些对他们来说都不重要。

lines.en: I watch her fingers pluck away the strings, having no clue of how much talent or dexterity is required to play this song she apparently wrote herself, but I’m impressed nonetheless. Just like she wanted.
lines.zh: 我看着她的手指拨动琴弦，完全不知道要弹好这首据说是她自己写的歌需要多少才华和技巧，但我还是被震撼了。正如她所愿。

lines.en: Is this good enough?
lines.zh: 这样够好吗？

lines.en: Is my expression what you hoped for when you pictured yourself up on that stage?
lines.zh: 我此刻的表情，是你在想象自己站在那个舞台上时所希望看到的吗？

lines.en: I attempt to contort my face into a smile and give up halfway through, causing a smirk to spawn at the corners of her lips as she understands I’m not good at that sort of thing.
lines.zh: 我试着把脸挤出一个笑容，挤到一半就放弃了；她明白我不擅长这种事，嘴角因此浮起一抹坏笑。

lines.en: What do I do in a position like this? There are people swaying in motion with the song, but...that’s not something I’d normally do, is it? Do I even know how?
lines.zh: 处在这种境地，我该怎么办？有人在随着歌摇摆，可是……那不是我平常会做的事，对吧？我到底知不知道该怎么做？

lines.en: My stomach drops what feels like a whole inch for every second I think about it, but I know it shouldn’t. This song is too pretty to elicit a reaction like that. Right?
lines.zh: 每想一秒，我的胃就好像往下沉了一英寸，可我知道它不该这样。这首歌这么好听，不该引出这种反应。对吧？

lines.en: I shouldn’t feel this way. This isn’t what she wants. This is supposed to make me happy.
lines.zh: 我不该有这种感觉。这不是她想要的。这本来应该是让我开心的。

lines.en: {i}Am{/i} I happy? What do I feel? Why can’t I put a finger on it?
lines.zh: 我{i}开心{/i}吗？我到底在感受什么？为什么我说不上来？

lines.en: That’s right. Fingers. I can go back to watching her play. That will keep my mind off of everything I- no.
lines.zh: 对了。手指。我可以回去看她弹琴。那样我就不会再去想那些我——不。

lines.en: I locked eyes with her again. I locked eyes with her and her expression didn’t change at all.
lines.zh: 我又一次和她对上了眼。我和她对上了眼，而她的表情一点都没变。

lines.en: Did she expect me to look this way? How does she remain so focused?
lines.zh: 她早就料到我会是这副样子吗？她是怎么做到这么专注的？

lines.en: How can she freely express so much when I struggle to express anything at all?
lines.zh: 为什么她能如此自由地表达那么多，而我却连表达一点东西都这么吃力？

lines.en: Is it because she’s simply that talented? (She is)
lines.zh: 是因为她就是那么有才华吗？（她是）

lines.en: Is it because she’s simply that determined? (She is)
lines.zh: 是因为她就是那么坚定吗？（她是）

lines.en: Or is it because she’s far more special...and far more important to me than I’ve given her credit for thus far? (Once more, she is)
lines.zh: 还是因为她远比我想象的更特别……对我而言也远比迄今为止我所承认的更重要？（再一次，她是）

lines.en: It is at this point that a woman standing beside me bumps her elbow into my bicep, likely expecting me to look over so she can say something like “Go get her” or anything comparable to that.
lines.zh: 就在这时，站在我旁边的一个女人用胳膊肘碰了碰我的二头肌，大概是想让我转过头去，好让她说一句「上啊，拿下她」之类的话。

lines.en: But, no matter how hard I try, I can not remove my eyes from Noriko.
lines.zh: 但无论我怎么努力，都没法把视线从 Noriko 身上挪开。

lines.en: She’s claimed them as her own and would be clutching them in the palms of her hands if they were not so busy enabling her seemingly endless serenade.
lines.zh: 她已经把我的眼睛据为己有；如果不是它们正忙着成全她那似乎永无止境的小夜曲，她大概会把我这双眼睛捧在手心里。

lines.en: Make it stop.
lines.zh: 让它停下来。

lines.en: Make these feelings go away.
lines.zh: 让这些感觉消失。

lines.en: I don’t want them anymore.
lines.zh: 我不再想要它们了。

lines.en: I don’t want them anymore.
lines.zh: 我不再想要它们了。

lines.en: I don’t-
lines.zh: 我不——

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko23
Noriko abruptly stops playing and, in doing so, frees me from the tendrils budding out of all of the things I don’t yet understand about myself.
lines.zh: Noriko 突然停下了演奏，也就在这一刻，她把我从那些由「我尚未理解的自己」生出的卷须里解救了出来。

lines.en: I’m the same as her.
lines.zh: 我和她一样。

lines.en: Still growing. Figuring out who I am.
lines.zh: 都还在成长。都还在搞清楚自己是谁。

lines.en: But why?
lines.zh: 可是为什么？

lines.en: I’m in my thirties. I should know this by now.
lines.zh: 我都三十多岁了。这种事我早该知道了。

lines.en: Why is she moving so much faster than me? Why can she do things like this while I can’t even-
lines.zh: 为什么她前进的速度比我快这么多？为什么她能做出这样的事，而我却连——

lines.en: : Sorry, everyone. I forget the rest.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，各位。后面的我忘了。

lines.en: An awkward combination of boos and half-hushed claps joins the fray...but Noriko remains on the stage.
lines.zh: 一阵尴尬的嘘声和压着一半的掌声混在一起……但 Noriko 仍然站在台上。

lines.en: Looking down at me after spending all of her life looking up.
lines.zh: 她用了一辈子抬头看我，此刻却在低头看着我。

lines.en: : What do you think, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你觉得怎么样，老师？

lines.en: : Am I impressive?
lines.zh: : 我够让人刮目相看吗？

lines.en: scene black
She is.
lines.zh: 她是。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko24
: Heheh...heh...
: I felt really confident when I was standing up there, but...now that I’m in front of you again, I-
lines.zh: : 我站在上面的时候还挺自信的，可是……现在又站到你面前了，我——

lines.en: : You were amazing.
lines.zh: : 你太棒了。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko25
: I...was?
lines.zh: : 我……很棒吗？

lines.en: : You were.
lines.zh: : 你很棒。

lines.en: : I don’t think the crowd was very pleased with how abruptly you ended the song, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你那么突然就把歌结束了，观众好像不太满意。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko26
: Well...yeah. There was more, but...it seemed like you were starting to feel a little uncomfortable. Which is definitely my fault for putting you in such a weird position with zero warning and-
lines.zh: : 嗯……是啊。后面还有的，不过……你看起来开始有点不自在了。这肯定是我的错，我一声招呼都没打就把你推到那么奇怪的位置上，而且——

lines.en: : I was uncomfortable, yeah.
lines.zh: : 我当时确实不自在了。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko27
: It was a lot to just spring on me out of nowhere and I had no idea how I was supposed to react or...how many people had their eyes on me.
lines.zh: : 毫无预兆地突然来这么一下，信息量太大了，我完全不知道该怎么反应，也不知道……有多少双眼睛在看着我。

lines.en: : Sensei...I didn’t mean to-
lines.zh: : 老师……我不是故意——

lines.en: : But it was amazing.
lines.zh: : 但那真的太棒了。

lines.en: scene datewarnoriko28
: {i}You{/i} were amazing.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}太棒了。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : 老师……

lines.en: : And I’ll be patiently waiting to see what you’ll be like when you exit the prototype stage.
lines.zh: : 我会耐心等着看，等你走出原型机阶段之后会是什么样子。

lines.en: scene black
: Because something tells me that you’ll be even {i}more{/i} amazing than you are right now.
lines.zh: : 因为我有种感觉，到那时你会比现在{i}更{/i}加了不起。

lines.en: Sometime after that, we leave the venue together.
lines.zh: 那之后过了一阵子，我们一起离开了演出场地。

lines.en: I can’t remember if we held hands again or not.
lines.zh: 我记不清我们有没有再牵手。

lines.en: But I remember the moment Noriko left so she could head back to the hotel a little earlier than the rest of the girls.
lines.zh: 但我记得 Noriko 离开时的那一刻——她比其他的女孩早一点回酒店。

lines.en: And I remember the way her sister’s billboard-eyes followed me as I hung my head on the way down the street, pondering which pink-haired girl I’d be happier with.
lines.zh: 我也记得，当我低着头沿街道走去、心里盘算着和哪个粉头发的女孩在一起会更幸福时，她姐姐那双广告牌般的眼睛一路跟着我。

lines.en: Or if I’ll ever be happy at all.
lines.zh: 又或者，我到底会不会幸福。

lines.en: $ dormwartwo6 = True
$ noriko_love += 5
{i}Noriko’s affection has increased to [noriko_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Noriko 的好感度提升到了 [noriko_love]!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Shortly after that...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那之后不久……{/i}
